title: docs(spec): a cleared optional multi-value field is stored as null, in FieldSchema's multiple and required docs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBAoBepdw1XbHyLW2fvste1k)_

Fixes #29652

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — `git grep` over `skills/**` for the empty-representation claim (`never null`, `reads back as []`, `emptied`) finds no page that teaches it; the hand-written `content/docs/**` pages that do are listed under the census below and move with the write-door PR that changes the behaviour

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`FieldSchema` 的 `multiple` / `required` 说明（docblock 与 `multiple` 的 describe）改为裁决后的规则：可选多值字段被清空时存 `null`（与从未赋值相同），写入 `[]` 或 `''` 也存 `null`；`required` 仍表示非空列表；`$empty` 表不变。重新生成了 3 个 references 页面。
- 为什么改：执行 #29343 裁决 A（记录 6591577985，「A:存 null,先修 #9447 spec 文本」），它推翻了 #9447「清空后读回 `[]`、永不 `null`」对可选列的那半句；按裁决先落 spec 文本，#29343 的写入口 PR 被本卡阻塞。
- 风险与回滚：只改文字，不动任何键、默认值或可接受集合；运行时行为由 #29343 的 PR 改，本 PR 落地后、那个 PR 落地前，文档先于行为。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`（`multiple` 的 docblock 与 describe，≈:1357-1380；`required` 的 docblock，≈:1314-1321）、`.changeset/29652-multi-value-empty-null-docs.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "never .null" -- packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts content/docs/references`，应只剩一行：field.zod.ts:1367，docblock 里被推翻的原句引文（修改前 field.zod.ts 3 处、3 个 references 页面共 5 处）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Text only, in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` (measured on `origin/main` `1c1a5d40`; the line numbers are unchanged at the final merge base `0b2b309c`), plus one comment in `filter-empty-operator.ts` and the regenerated references. No key, default, accept set or export moves.

**`required` doc block (≈:1314).**

- Before: "The empty set is always representable (it reads back as `[]`, never `null` — see `multiple`), so the required check judges emptiness, not absence."
- After: "An emptied OPTIONAL multi-value field is stored as `null`, the same as one never set (see `multiple`), so the required check judges emptiness: `null` and `[]` both fail it." The cite now reads "(#9447, maintainer ruling 2026-08-18; this half stands under ruling A on #29343, record 6591577985)".
- The `required` describe is unchanged: its sentence ("`[]` does not satisfy it") is the half of #9447 the ruling keeps.

**`multiple` doc block (≈:1357).**

- Before: "Multi-value empty representation (#9447, maintainer ruling 2026-08-18): an emptied multi-value lookup reads back as `[]`, never `null`. This binds … EVERY writer … an array field always reads as an array, so readers (generated code, formula/filter predicates) never need a null branch."
- After: "Multi-value empty representation (ruling A on #29343, record 6591577985, amending #9447, maintainer ruling 2026-08-18): a cleared OPTIONAL multi-value field — every type `isMultiValueField` answers true for … — is stored as `null` by the write door, the same as one never set, unique-covered or not: `[]` and `''` written to it store `null`. This binds … EVERY writer … It reverses #9447's sentence for optional columns: readers meet `null` for an empty set, and read `null` and `[]` alike as empty, since a row stored before the rule can still hold `[]`. The `$empty` table's `multi_value` row is unchanged … #9447's other half stands: `required` on a multi-value field means non-empty list."
- "readers never need a null branch" is dropped.

**`multiple` describe (≈:1380).** The rule only, no tracker id.

- Before: "An emptied multi-value lookup reads back as `[]`, never `null` — the rule binds every writer (cascade repair, form clears, API writes), not just cascade repair."
- After: "A cleared optional multi-value field is stored as `null`, the same as one never set: an empty list `[]` or an empty string written to it stores `null`, and the rule binds every writer (cascade repair, form clears, API writes). Read `null` and `[]` alike as empty, as the `is_empty` filter (`$empty`) does, since a row stored before this rule can still hold `[]`. On a `required` multi-value field the empty list is refused: `required` means a non-empty list."

**`filter-empty-operator.ts` docblock (≈:91), the one other `packages/spec` hit.**

- Before: "a field whose value is a list is emptied to `[]`."
- After: "a field whose value is a list can hold `[]` (a cleared optional one stores `null`, but a row stored before that rule can still hold `[]`)." The `$empty` table and `expandEmptyOperator` are untouched.

**Generated.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `check:generated` named one stale artifact (`content/docs/references/**`); `gen:docs` rewrote the `multiple` row in three pages, because `FieldSchema` is rendered in each: `references/data/field.mdx`, `references/data/object.mdx` (2 rows) and `references/system/migration.mdx` (2 rows). `check:generated` then reported all 14 artifacts current.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/29652-multi-value-empty-null-docs.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, both declaration lines at line start.

## Why

Ruling A on #29343 (record 6591577985), verbatim: 「A:存 null,先修 #9447 spec 文本」 — 「spec 席先改 field.zod.ts 的 multiple/required 说明,再落本卡 PR(代码已建好),另开一张清理已存 '[]' 的 migrate 卡。」

**The declarations, measured.**

- `Metadata-protocol: semantic`. The `Check Changeset` "WHICH LEVEL" text: "`semantic` — the meaning or default of an authorable key changes → `minor`". `multiple` is an authorable key, and what it promises about the stored empty value changes; the published describe is that promise. The counter-reading is the `none` row's "description or error text", which is for wording that leaves the meaning alone. So `semantic`, and `@objectstack/spec` takes `minor`.
- `Clause-②: yes`, no arm. A published semantic contract changes, and no accept set moves, so neither `(widening)` nor `(narrowing)` applies.
- **ADR-0087.** `check-adr-0087-registration` asks for a disposition only on a changeset that declares a breaking change; this one does not. The gate exits 0. No `SemanticMigration` entry is written. Stored `'[]'` values are the ruling's step 3, a separate `os migrate` data card.

## Census: the "`[]`, never `null`" claim

`git grep` on `1c1a5d40` for `never null`, `` never `null` ``, `reads back as []`, `emptied`, `9447`, and `multi-value` near `[]`:

- **`packages/spec/**`, amended here:** `field.zod.ts:1316-1317` (`required` docblock), `:1357-1364` (`multiple` docblock), `:1371` (`multiple` describe); `filter-empty-operator.ts:91`.
- **`packages/spec/**`, read and left:** `value-roundtrip-conformance.ts:216` (`m_empty`, "empty array must not degrade to null") is the driver round-trip table, below the write door, and the ruling does not change what a driver returns for a written `[]`. The `null`-or-`[]` rows in `filter-empty-operator.ts`, `filter.zod.ts:1802`/`:2948` and `filter-logic-conformance.ts:80` are the unchanged `$empty` table. `CHANGELOG.md:48935` is release-owned. The other `never null` hits (`organization.zod.ts`, `solution-blueprint.zod.ts`, tests) are other subjects.
- **`skills/**`:** 0 hits.
- **Hand-written `content/docs/**`, findings, not edited here:** each says an emptied `multiple: true` set is written or read back as `[]`, never `null`, and most point at the `multiple` doc block as their source:
  - `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx:279`
  - `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx:1025`
  - `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx:295`
  - `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx:265` (and the #9447 cite at `:274`)
  - `content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx:254`
  - `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx:730`

  They describe what the runtime does today, which changes only with the write-door PR on #29343. Moving them there keeps each page true on every merged commit.

## Tests

No test changes: no tested behaviour moves. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: on the final head `3e61ed73`, under `os-verify-lock`: Test Files 803 passed (803), Tests 23795 passed, 1 todo. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` ran in the same chain, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The two earlier heads read the same: `f05af6cb` (803/803 files, 23786 passed) and `8b1ecbbc` after the first `origin/main` merge (803/803, 23792 passed).

## Acceptance notes

- Docs before behaviour, by the ruling's order: until the PR on #29343 lands, the write door still stores `[]` as sent on these columns, so for a while the describe states a rule the runtime has not applied yet.
- The `required` describe still says "On a multi-value lookup (`multiple: true`)". It is narrower than the rule (which covers every multi-value type) but not false. Widening it is outside the file surface this card claims.
- `field.zod.ts` also moved on `main` while this was open: #29623 (`87956dcc`) landed and was merged in, a different region, and the regenerated references keep only this PR's `multiple` rows against `main`. PR #29553 (#29415) edits the same file near :1822, also a different region; the later lander merges `origin/main`.
- Author of this body: `domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzeW5cprrZRccVNgPFr`. Lines 1 to 3 belong to the attribution block and the closing line, so the signature is here rather than first.

## Verification

Every reading here is on the final head `3e61ed73`: the branch merged with `origin/main` at `0b2b309c`. The delta against `main` is exactly the 6 files above, 45 insertions and 20 deletions.

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2`: 118/118 tasks, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 96 families from 6 changed paths. Each ran serially and was recorded as `CMD :: exit N`: **96 exit 0**. `dispatch-gates --ran` reported "96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event FILE`, with this body as the event: exit 0. Its verdict: "LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `yes` and metadata-protocol `semantic`, and no package whose published source … it moves is graded `patch`".
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: exit 0. No changeset here declares a breaking change, so the gate asks for no disposition.

<details><summary>Earlier heads</summary>

On `f05af6cb` (before any merge), the same 96 ran: 89 exit 0 and 7 exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). The 7 lacked a built `dist` for `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/client-react` and `@objectstack/objectql`, or needed the `check-plugin-teardown-shape` fixture commit that the shallow clone was missing. After a full build and a fetch of that fixture commit, all 7 exited 0. On `8b1ecbbc` (after the first merge), all 96 exited 0.

</details>

Not run locally, left for CI: `pnpm lint`, the `test:repo` project, and the full dogfood suite (the title has no `!` and the PR declares no `(narrowing)` arm).
